thread:
alex.j: hey @support — customer ACME reports tool calling is flaky when they call two tools in parallel. sometimes the tool_result ids are swapped and schema validation fails. logs attached below.

maria_g: thanks alex. do we have a repro? customer says it only happens under load (concurrent=4+), and only with function-mode tools (not plugin).

josh_k: assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml. @eng-runtime can you triage?

eng-bot: incident created #INC-20250315-47, priority: high, assignees: eng-runtime.

sarah_ops: summary from customer: POST /v1/call returns 200, but body has tool_result with wrong schema. they expect toolA result shape {"answer": string} and toolB {"items": []}. occasionally toolA's payload arrives labeled toolB and fails validation downstream. leads to downstream 500s and some duplicate billing.

alex.j: pasted minimal repro payload the customer used:```json
{
  "model": "rw-infer-1",
  "input": "Get inventory and summary",
  "tools": [
    {"name": "get_inventory", "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"items": {"type":"array"}}}},
    {"name": "summarize", "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"answer": {"type":"string"}}}
  ],
  "parallel": true,
  "request_id": "cust-7812"
}
```

maria_g: customer provided server logs showing these two consecutive responses:```log
2025-03-15T12:01:02.345Z req=cust-7812 call=get_inventory status=200 tool_result_id=tr-9 payload={"answer":"..."}
2025-03-15T12:01:02.346Z req=cust-7812 call=summarize status=200 tool_result_id=tr-10 payload={"items":[]}
2025-03-15T12:01:02.350Z req=cust-7812 router: associated tool_result_id=tr-9 -> summarize
```
This shows router hooked wrong IDs.

josh_k: interesting. could be a concurrency map in the router keyed by an ephemeral slot rather than request+tool. any recent routing changes?

eng-runtime: looking. no deliberate changes to router mapping in last deploy but we did push a batching micro-optimization that reuses same slot object for ephemeral calls to avoid allocations. might be related. in prod we use continuous batching + parallel tool workers.

alex.j: customer also reported schema validation errors in their processing service: "expected items array but found string". they attached a screenshot of our response body header: Content-Type: application/json, X-Request-Id: cust-7812, X-Tool-Result-Id: tr-9

maria_g: action items initial: 1) eng-runtime reproduce locally with parallel=4 and same tool definitions, 2) capture correlation between internal tool_result_id and tool.name, 3) check for mutable shared state in router.

eng-runtime: repro guide I used: set up two stub tools that sleep different durations, then fire 8 parallel calls. script:```bash
# repro.sh
for i in $(seq 1 8); do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/call \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
    -H "X-Request-Id: repro-$i" \
    -d '{"model":"rw-infer-1","input":"x","tools":[{"name":"slow","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}}}},{"name":"fast","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array"}}}],"parallel":true}' &
done
wait
```
results: saw ~10% of requests where tool_result labels didn't match the payload shape.

josh_k: thanks. can you dump a router trace of a failing example? need stack, exact timestamps, and in-memory mapping.

eng-runtime: attached trace snippet (redacted):```text
[router] 0x7f3a slot=42 assign tool_slot=fast -> tool_result_id tr-203
[worker:fast] produced tool_result_id tr-203 payload={"items":[...]} duration=12ms
[router] slot=42 now assigned tool=slow -> tool_result_id tr-204
[worker:slow] produced tool_result_id tr-204 payload={"answer":"..."} duration=60ms
[router] finalize request: output tool_result_map={fast: tr-204, slow: tr-203}
```
looks like finalize swapped ids by referencing slot index twice. suspect off-by-one or reuse of mutable map.

sarah_ops: customer saw increased latency during the window and also reported duplicate billing entries for tool executions. billing flagged two charges where only one should have occurred. could be caused by retries around validation failures. we need billing team looped in if confirmed.

alex.j: temp mitigation for customer: set "parallel": false to force serial tool calls. customer said serial works and unblocks current app. also suggested we add a flag to route-by-tool-name strictly.

maria_g: eng-runtime, can you push hotfix? maybe deep-copy the per-request map at finalize, avoid reusing slot objects across requests. add extra assert in dev build comparing tool_result shapes to expected schema before labeling.

eng-runtime: plan: revert allocation optimization on router slots, add unit test that runs thousands of parallel combinations, and add defensive copy + assertion. will do a canary deploy to staging first. PR 5123 created.

josh_k: please include reproducer script and failing trace in PR. also include a migration note for logging to surface tool_result_id->tool.name mapping (helpful for debugging).

eng-runtime: will do. ETA for staging canary: 3 hours. ETA for prod patch after validation: 24-48 hours.

alex.j: notified customer of workaround and ETA. customer asks about billing refunds for the double charges.

sarah_ops: I've opened a billing ticket and privacy-safe audit to compute the exact duplicate executions for reqs with cust-7812 between 2025-03-15T12:00 and 12:15. billing team assigned.

ops-bot: billing-ticket BT-998 created, link: https://billing.redwood.dev/tickets/BT-998

maria_g: follow-ups: - eng-ml to review tool invocation ordering semantics (are we guaranteed tool-slot to tool.name mapping under parallel?), - eng-runtime to harden router, - support to coordinate customer comms and refund flow.

eng-runtime: quick note: found a lurking race when two workers finish in the same millisecond and router finalizer iterates over shared vector while workers are still updating it. adding a small synchronization barrier resolves repro in our tests.

alex.j: closing loop: customer confirmed serial workaround good. will keep them on watch while we roll patch. thanks team :thumbsup:

maria_g: added follow-up doc in #eng-runtime for postmortem; we'll convert to a public KB entry for customers on best practices (when to avoid parallel tool calls) and include recommended SDK changes to attach per-tool UUIDs rather than relying on slot indices.

josh_k: please ping me once prod patch is live.

eng-bot: incident INC-20250315-47 status: tracking -> fix in progress.

sarah_ops: last note — customer wants the invoice credit applied before EOD PST if possible. billing team acknowledged.

alex.j: thanks all, closing thread when patch is in prod.
